Data scientist focused on deploying ML-driven products and computer vision models for business impact. Notice period: 60 days.

Data Scientist, Finlytics — Mar 2024 - Present
At Finlytics I designed and deployed a computer vision pipeline to extract structured data from scanned financial documents, improving automated data capture accuracy and throughput. Implemented Deep Learning models for document classification and OCR post-processing, reducing manual review by 48%. Built end-to-end model training and experiment tracking using MLflow and productionized feature pipelines with pandas. Coordinated sprints and tracked progress in Jira with cross-functional teams.

Data Scientist, Medisure — Feb 2023 - Feb 2024
At Medisure I led development of predictive models for claims fraud detection, using ML feature engineering and Deep Learning techniques to flag anomalous claims patterns. Managed experiments and model versioning using MLflow, and implemented scalable data transformations with pandas to support daily retraining. Collaborated with stakeholders through Jira-driven workflows to integrate models into claims processing, achieving a significant reduction in false positives.

Skills: Python, ML, pandas, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, MLflow, Jira

Education: B.Com, Narsee Monjee College
